name: Western and Eastern Armenia map coverage

properties.method: The uploaded provinces coverage polygon was partitioned by the Western/Eastern membership of the 15 province polygons. Tiny source precision slivers were assigned to the touching division so the two output polygons cover the uploaded boundary exactly without overlap.

properties.source: Partitioned from the user-uploaded map coverage with the 15 historical province boundaries
Partitioned from the user-uploaded map coverage with the 15 historical province boundaries

territoryMeasurements.method: Geodesic calculation on the WGS84 ellipsoid from the supplied GeoJSON geometry
territoryMeasurements.note: Historical boundaries are interpretive; measurements are cartographic estimates, not legal or cadastral values.
